selection: All trajectory files in five official mini-SWE-agent v2 model submissions; source availability, not outcome. Same benchmark issues recur across models.
caveats: Same benchmark issues recur across models; trajectory count is not the number of independent issues.
Input totals already include cached input and cache creation; those fields are subsets, not additional tokens.
Reasoning tokens are included in output totals.
Recorded cost is historical source-harness accounting, not our spending or an independently reconciled invoice.
Each native response is one model call even when it contains multiple tool actions.
Reported API-call counters can exceed stored response records (for example failed attempts); their missing usage is not imputed.
This corpus was not screened for overlap with previous discovery data; it is not held-out evaluation.
Only aggregate counts and source links are published; raw trajectories remain private.
